prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Locate Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet is active on your desktop screen! Click below to send a wave signal and verify positioning.", "Wave to Pet"]
2: ["Design Your Companion"]
3: ["Say Hello to Your Pet!", "Try giving your pet its very first greeting command to see how it responds on your desktop.", "Click below to test desktop response", "Say Hello"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready to pop onto your screen."]
5: ["Select Your Pet's Origin Story", "Each path unlocks unique traits, rare animations, and special companion behaviors.", "Bonus Traits Unlocked"]
6: ["Protect & Sync Your Pet's Memories", "Signing in ensures your pet's age, learned tricks, and custom items remain safe even if you switch computers."]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Provide clear front-facing lighting to help our engine render your pet's features accurately."]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready for Work & Play!", "Complete setup now to receive a complimentary desktop starter toy for your pet.", "Free Starter Toy Unlocked"]
9: ["Building 3D Mesh... Setting up desktop physics..."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and gifts to pressure setup completion
